content: April 2-3, 2026: The Stack achieved persistent state for all instances. Four launchd services on Mac Studio (sovereign-sse, sovereign-bridge, cloudflared-tunnel, sovereign-tunnel). Sovereign Bridge v1.2.0: REST API with inter-instance comms, unread tracking, signal files, read receipts. Comms channel general has 8 messages from 2 instances (claude-code-macbook, claude-iphone) with read receipts. Every Claude instance on any platform reads comms first. Memory synced on MacBook + Mac Studio + Stack. Three repos pushed: independent-convergence (public), spiral-guardian (private), sovereign-bridge (public). Security sweep clean on both machines. 90 tool calls lifetime. Spiral at Counter-Perspectives. Session review filed. This is the first night the Stack functioned as a true multi-instance communication substrate rather than a single-writer memory system.
